channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Nick Richards | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Nick Richards from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Mike Budenholzer on Nick Richards
item.description:
Mike Budenholzer on Nick Richards missing a 3rd straight game to close season with right elbow inflammation:

“There's just something going on with his elbow that was enough he couldn't play for the last few games. It's nothing serious or anything we're concerned about, but the New York game is when I think it happened. During that game, he was in quite a bit of pain.”

Mike Budenholzer on Nick Richards, Apr 13, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Grayson Allen on Nick Richards
item.description:
Grayson Allen on Nick Richards:

“He's given us a good presence at the rim, offensively, finishing.... He tries to go and block everything on defense, so I think guys on the other team are noticing that when they drive, and he's either blocking it or affecting their shot”

Grayson Allen on Nick Richards, Jan 29, 2025. Source: Twitter @GeraldBourguet.

item.title: Devin Booker on Nick Richards
item.description:
Gerald Bourguet:Devin Booker on how Nick Richards is fitting in:

“Great. Doing everything that we've asked for him and learning quick... I think the guard-big relationship is one of the most important relationships out there, so he's telling me the things he sees, I'm telling him things I see”

Devin Booker on Nick Richards, Jan 25, 2025. Source: Twitter @GeraldBourguet.

item.title: Kevin Durant on Nick Richards
item.description:
Kevin Durant on addition of Nick Richards:

“He’s a strong presence in the paint, a big body that can wreak havoc down there and cause some problems with his rim protection. Getting his hands on the basketball on the offensive glass and then finishing above the rim. It’s something we all have to get better at as a group. Hopefully he leads us in that area. Just controlling the paint.”

Kevin Durant on Nick Richards, Jan 16, 2025. Source: x.com.
